note: Wooded Forest Service campground in three loops beside the North Fork of the White River, across from the Devils Backbone Wilderness; boat access and day-use area at the river. The river is a short walk through the trees and shows from some sites only when the leaves are down. Trailhead for the Ridge Runner and Blue Spring trails. Fee tube, cash or check. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Forest Service page: open (status 'Site Open'), 19 FCFS sites, $10, no hookups, some sites to 34 ft, season May 1 - Dec 1 (was approximate May-Dec 31). No alert names this campground. Waterfront: the agency itself says the river is seen only before leaf-out - downgrade recommended. Pin is on the loops.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverview) - DOWNGRADE to not waterfront recommended: the Forest Service page says 'From the day use area, and sometimes the campground, you have amazing views looking across the river ... Some sites have views of the river before trees and bushes leaf out.' The campground is open May 1 - Dec 1, i.e. in leaf for nearly all of its season. On leaf-off imagery the three loops lie in continuous hardwood forest, the nearest (western) loop 50-70 m from the river with an unbroken timber belt between; no site has an open apron. The river view belongs to the day-use area. By the unsure-goes-down rule this is 'not waterfront'; apply.py does not write waterfront, so it is flagged.

POTABLE WATER not written - the page contradicts itself: 'Drinking water, vault toilets and garbage collection are centrally located' under Camping, and 'Water: Potable water is not available at this site' under Facility and Amenity Information.
PHONE (none stored): the page lists the ranger district office at 417-683-4428 ext 120.

Flood closures: none posted now. The forest alerts shown on the page are the Paddy Creek bridge closure, Chadwick Trail 119, Beaver Lake, Red Bridge Road and a weather-conditions notice; none names North Fork. The rig-length sentence is specific to this campground, not forest boilerplate, and admits a 23-ft rig.
Pin 36.7548,-92.1527 sits on the western camp loop on imagery; no move. (The page's coordinate 36.758606,-92.152801 is the highway bridge.) Not listed on recreation.gov (FCFS only).
A 50% Senior/Access pass discount is stated on the page (agency policy; not written per entry).
